description: This file defines a Drupal 7 migration source plugin class 'NodeEntityTranslation' for migrating node entity translations from the database, including query construction, row preparation, and field definitions.

classes.name: NodeEntityTranslation
classes.description: A Drupal 7 migration source plugin class for node entity translations, extending FieldableEntity, providing query, row preparation, field definitions, and ID configuration.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Constructs and returns a database query to retrieve node translation data, joining relevant tables and applying optional node type filtering.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each source row by fetching entity fields, handling translatable fields, and replacing the title if a custom title field exists.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array describing the fields available in the source data, with labels.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the unique identifiers for the source data: entity_id and language.
